verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a self-serve sandbox key (pk1_sb_) that runs every API operation—registrations, DNS changes, webhooks—against a simulated environment with fake credit and no real charges, plus a zero-setup mock mirror of every endpoint requiring no key or account, and a dryRun flag for pre-flight checks. This directly satisfies the story of self-serve credentials and safe, cost-free testing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation that the sandbox works as documented (evidence is vendor docs only, no community corroboration).
